stages.demand_extraction_desc: Synthesize live industrial vacancies and district labour market signals
stages.iti_capacity_desc: Allocate course intake targets and seat adjustments across district ITIs
stages.equipment_review_desc: Audit workshop machinery, tooling gaps, and trainer upskilling needs
stages.submission_desc: Final district plan review, officer confirmation, and state sanction

reasons.demand_extraction_incomplete: Demand extraction step must be initialized first
reasons.capacity_incomplete: Course intake targets must be completed and validated
reasons.equipment_incomplete: Equipment deficit review must be completed before submission

helpers.justification_hint: Required when proposed seats change by more than 50% (minimum 20 characters).

reasons.stages_incomplete: All stages must be completed before submitting the plan.

validation.seat_count_integer: Seat count must be a whole integer.
validation.justification_min_length: Seat adjustment exceeding 50% requires at least 20 characters of justification.
validation.qty_integer: Quantity must be a whole integer.
validation.trainer_count_integer: Trainer count must be a whole integer.
